title: fix(security): roles are no longer chosen by the browser or trusted from headers (SEC-1b, ADR-0043)

sourceMetadata.subject: fix(security): roles are no longer chosen by the browser or trusted from headers (SEC-1b, ADR-0043)
sourceMetadata.body:
Runtime authorized project access from x-korelumina-role, -user-id and -team-id headers that the browser sets and nothing verified: a caller claiming super_admin saw every project. Signed-out visitors defaulted to inhouse-dev, any role in localStorage was honoured, Settings offered every user a role switcher up to Super admin, the simulated checkout granted plan roles client-side, and with Supabase the role came from user_metadata, which users can edit themselves. Now signed-out visitors are plain users; browser role switching, the localStorage override and the simulated checkout work only in development builds; the Supabase role is read from server-written app_metadata and cannot be set from the browser (the owner's super_admin role was moved to app_metadata in Supabase and verified); and Runtime believes caller headers only with the internal token or from this machine outside production. ADR-0043, accepted by the owner, decides the hosted model: the browser sends a verified Supabase session token, never a role, and roles are assigned server-side; SEC-1c to SEC-1e and BILL-1 implement it.
